title.narrative: Breaking The Barriers - TB Community Led Models

description.narrative: (India): ..This mechanism is a key component of USAID's Global.Accelerator to End Tuberculosis. There has been a strong commitment for a.TB-free India from the highest levels of the Government of India, which has an.ambitious National Strategic Plan (NSP) to eliminate TB by 2025. The burden of.undetected TB is high in many settings, especially in high-risk groups which.are identified under the country's new National Strategic Plan (2017-25)..Mapping of high-risk groups and carefully planned systematic screening for active.disease among them has improved early case detection that may help to reduce.the risks of TB transmission, poor treatment outcomes, undesirable health.consequences, and adverse social and economic effects of the disease. This.project will develop and scale up effective behavior change operational models.that improves coverage of vulnerable populations, such as urban poor, tribal.communities, migrants and mining/industrial workers, for increased case.notification, improved successful treatment outcomes in Drug Sensitive-TB,.TB-HIV and Drug Resistant-TB patients, thereby supporting the government of.India to eliminate TB by 2025 while still factoring in the COVID-19 context..Given the diversity across India and within states, this project recognizes the.need for multiple context-specific models to achieve the overall 'End TB' goal..It will be in alignment with the efforts made under the National Tuberculosis.Elimination program (NTEP) to actively engage various stakeholders including.civil society and communities in program planning and design, service delivery,.monitoring, and advocacy while also safeguarding the spread of COVID-19...
